title: Intersection of Three Sorted Arrays
summary: Provide a sorted array containing only the integers that are present in all three given integer arrays, which are sorted in strictly increasing order.
statement: Provide a sorted array containing only the integers that are present in all three given integer arrays, which are sorted in strictly increasing order.
constraints: All three arrays are strictly increasing.
Return their common values in increasing order.
hints: Compare one current value from each sorted array.
On equality emit it and advance all three; otherwise advance every pointer at the minimum current value.
Stop when any array is exhausted.
A minimum value cannot match later values in the other arrays, so discarding it is safe.
editorial: A minimum value cannot match later values in the other arrays, so discarding it is safe.

tests.explanation: One and five appear in all three arrays.
No value is shared by every array.
